source_note: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题
english_source_note: Equivalent Conditions for Convergence in Measure
callout_id: 有限测度空间上依测度收敛的等价命题#3
statement_en: Assume the previous equivalence were true without requiring the measure space to be finite. On $(\mathbb{R}, \text{Lebesgue measure})$, consider $f_n(x) := (x+1/n)^2$. Then $f_n(x) \to x^2$ for every $x$, so every subsequence and every further subsequence also converges pointwise to $x^2$. However, $f_n$ does not converge to $x^2$ in Lebesgue measure, because for sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, $$\{x \in \mathbb{R} : (x+1/n)^2 - x^2 \geq \varepsilon\} = [\tfrac{n\varepsilon}{2} - \tfrac{n}{2}, +\infty),$$ and this set has infinite measure for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Hence the sequence does not converge to $x^2$ in measure, contradicting the claimed extension.
key_techniques: construction on an infinite measure space
callout_body: 假设命题成立不需要测度空间是有限的，那么在实数的Lebesgue测度空间上考虑函数列$f_n(x):=(x+1/n)^2$。这个函数列处处收敛到$x^2$,因此它的子列以及子列的子列都是处处收敛到$x^2$的。但是这个序列并不依Lebesgue测度收敛到$x^2$，因为对充分小的$\varepsilon$$$\{x\in \mathbb{R}:(x+1/n)^2-x^2\geq \varepsilon\}=[\frac{n\varepsilon}{2}-\frac{n}{2},+\infty)$$对任意的$n\in \mathbb{N}$而言这个集合的测度都是无穷的。因此该序列不会依测度收敛到$x^2$,这就与命题矛盾了。
